_test_case_note: v0.0.2 ASN.1 GGSN -- one self-contained job+pipeline decoding the real GGSN.asn1 module (metaflow_testing/BT_Testing/GGSN.asn1) into metaflow.bronze_ggsn.ggsn_cdr_raw. ROOT PDU AUTO-DETECTION IS THE HEADLINE: asn1_pdu_name is deliberately OMITTED from source_config, so asn1/decoder.py::detect_root_pdu_name resolves the root PDU out of the module itself -- GGSN.asn1 -> CallEventRecord, verified by calling resolve_pdu_name(schema, None) directly against this schema. asn1_pdu_name became OPTIONAL in 0.0.2; an explicitly supplied value still wins as an override, but this spec exercises the detection path. CHOICE ROOT: CallEventRecord is a CHOICE with 13 arms, so the decoded frame carries one nullable column per arm PLUS the synthetic '_choice' discriminator naming the arm actually selected -- 14 columns in total, confirmed by derive_asn1_field_defs(schema, None). All 10 fixtures select sgsnMMRecord, so the other 12 arms are NULL on every row. ON THE FIXTURES: metaflow_testing/BT_Testing/synthetic/ggsn_synthetic.ber is NOT used, because it holds 10 records concatenated as back-to-back TLVs in ONE file, and the framework decoder calls compiled.decode() once on a whole file's bytes -- asn1tools then returns only the FIRST TLV silently, ingesting 1 row and dropping 9 while reporting success. notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/05_seed_asn1_ggsn_fixture.py therefore writes each record as its own .ber file (10 files -> 10 rows) and self-checks that invariant at seed time by re-encoding each decode and asserting the byte length matches the file length. ON THE DQ RULES: unlike EMSC/TAP, GGSN records are genuinely RICH -- 9-21 populated leaf values per record. Measured over these exact 10 deterministic records (random.Random(20260903 + i)), exactly five sgsnMMRecord members are populated on ALL 10: recordType, servedIMSI, recordOpeningTime, causeForRecClosing, chargingCharacteristics. Every other member is OPTIONAL and populated in only 2-6 of the 10 (duration in just 2), so asserting on any of those would false-quarantine valid records. dq_ggsn_mandatory_fields_present asserts exactly those five and nothing more, and the seed notebook verifies the same five at the source. record_id_column is '_choice', a genuine top-level column -- dq/quarantine.py requires the column to be in df.columns and silently ignores a dotted struct path.
_expected_result: bronze_ggsn.ggsn_cdr_raw holds exactly 10 rows. Every row: _asn1_decode_error IS NULL, _choice = 'sgsnMMRecord', sgsnMMRecord IS NOT NULL, and all 12 other CHOICE arms NULL. The sgsnMMRecord struct exposes the full member set derived from GGSN.asn1 with no schema mismatch or truncation; its five mandatory-in-practice members (recordType, servedIMSI, recordOpeningTime, causeForRecClosing, chargingCharacteristics) are non-null on every row, while the remaining OPTIONAL members are legitimately sparse, which is correct behaviour and not a defect. Quarantine table ggsn_cdr_raw_quarantine stays EMPTY.

ingestion_flows.source_description: v0.0.2: BER-encoded GGSN gateway-GPRS-support-node call event records decoded against the real GGSN.asn1 module. Root PDU is auto-detected (asn1_pdu_name omitted) as CallEventRecord, a 13-arm CHOICE -- decoding projects one column per arm plus the '_choice' discriminator. Fixtures are landed one record per .ber file by notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/05_seed_asn1_ggsn_fixture.py.

rules.expression: _choice <> 'sgsnMMRecord' OR (sgsnMMRecord.recordType IS NOT NULL AND sgsnMMRecord.servedIMSI IS NOT NULL AND sgsnMMRecord.recordOpeningTime IS NOT NULL AND sgsnMMRecord.causeForRecClosing IS NOT NULL AND sgsnMMRecord.chargingCharacteristics IS NOT NULL)
